meaning: A character used in transliterated names, as in 瑪利歐.
conceptZh: 大怪獸與小外星人揮舞泡棉筆畫決鬥，雙雙揮空轉圈撞頭，散落的筆畫落成「瑪」，最後握手跳進通往彩色世界的管道。
object: Deep turquoise foam stroke paddles forming 王 on the left and 馬 on the right, beside an original oval portal pipe.
morph: A gentle head bump knocks the foam strokes upward; they fall face-forward into the exact Traditional Chinese glyph 瑪.
creativeAngle: 保留跳管道到另一個世界的趣味，改用原創怪獸與外星人的揮空撞頭決鬥，避免模仿既有角色；「瑪利歐」是這隻怪獸的名字，以指向自己的動作對應語音，並讓撞擊直接造成筆畫落位。
promptEn:
Create an 8-second stylized 3D cartoon in one locked, front-facing wide shot. A huge round fuzzy apricot monster with one horn, tiny feet and a goofy grin faces a small green alien hovering at monster-head height in a toy saucer. The monster is an entirely original character named 瑪利歐; invent its appearance without borrowing any existing character, costume or franchise design. A low oval lavender pipe opens onto a peach-and-mint miniature world at the lower edge of the set. Pale butter background, soft light, saturated deep-turquoise foam strokes.

0.0–1.3s: The monster eagerly points toward the portal, then offers a playful duel to decide who enters first. Each contestant holds a fan of chunky foam stroke paddles: the monster has the 王 components, the alien the 馬 components. They grin and make enormous, clearly opposed wind-ups. The first spoken 瑪 accompanies the monster raising its stroke bundle to begin the build.

1.3–3.1s: Both swing horizontally and miss completely: the monster swings below the hovering alien, whose swing sails over the monster's horn. Their momentum turns each through one ridiculous full spin. The monster's fluffy backside wobbles; the saucer tilts like a spinning dinner plate. They finish facing each other again, leaning too far forward.

3.1–4.6s: Their foreheads meet with one soft rubbery boink. Both squash, rebound and sit down wearing dizzy grins. Their released foam paddles fly upward in two compact fans, then drop into a shallow, invisible front-facing assembly plane. The impact causes the arrangement: narrow 王 at left, full 馬 at right, including its distinct four bottom dots. Use an exact Traditional Chinese 瑪 glyph template for every stroke's silhouette, proportion, spacing and placement; flatten the foam faces into a single crisp, readable shape. Speak the second 瑪 exactly when the final stroke lands at 4.6s.

4.6–8.0s: Hold the completed 瑪 absolutely still, centered and uncropped at approximately 70% of frame height, with generous margins. Below it, the monster proudly points both thumbs at its own chest as the voice says its name, 瑪利歐. It then shakes the alien's hand; together they make a tiny hop into the pipe, emerging visibly inside its colorful miniature world and waving beneath the glyph without overlapping any strokes.

Audio: warm off-screen Taiwanese Mandarin, slowly and distinctly, exact line: "瑪、瑪、瑪利歐" (ㄇㄚˇ、ㄇㄚˇ、ㄇㄚˇ ㄌㄧˋ ㄡ). Schedule the utterances around 0.6s, 4.6s and 5.5–6.6s, with clear tones and pauses. Stop after the name. Gentle swishes and a quiet boink only; no extra dialogue. The sole visible text is 瑪: no name label, subtitles, logos, watermark, clutter or flashing effects.
direction: 超級瑪麗風格，跳到水管到另一個世界
